name: status:new
description: 新登记，尚未分级或复现

description: 已分级并确认处理优先级

name: status:reproducing
description: 正在复现并收集环境证据

description: 已包含在公开 Release 中

description: 发布后已验证安装、升级与关键功能

name: status:closed
description: 已完成并可关闭

name: status:blocked
description: 存在明确阻塞，当前无法推进

name: status:duplicate

name: status:cannot-reproduce
description: 证据不足或当前无法复现

name: status:wont-fix
description: 决定不修复或不在范围

name: status:reopened
description: 关闭后重新打开

description: 一般功能错误
